narration.text: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
The water went down, not in a day, but in a long steady retreat. And then, one morning, something shuddered through the whole ark. It stopped moving.
And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
